title: Gödel's incompleteness theorems have an SEP entry
summary: Panu Raatikainen's entry is the pointer. The theorems are not restated from memory as a formal result.
body: Panu Raatikainen's Stanford Encyclopedia entry on Gödel's incompleteness theorems is the secondary account used here. The usual informal statement is that any consistent formal system capable of a certain amount of arithmetic is incomplete, and that such a system cannot prove its own consistency. A precise statement has definitions the v1 pack does not contain. This card points at the entry rather than pretending a one-sentence version is the theorem. It is a seed, not a v1 conversion.
